This is a laid-back guide intended to help people optimizing their Hero usage! Rather than using only Starfire Squall, utilize combos to better your output!

Part 1: Basic Hero

Hero is a scion class that uses Sword, TMG, and Talis. They have a huge damage boost as long as you can avoid losing 20% of you max HP in 5 second.

*This guide assumes that**:
  • You know how PSO2 works in general, as you need 2 level 75 classes to unlock Hero
  • You have done the Hero Tutorial
  • You know who Stratos (ストラトス) is
  • You can amass Excubes
  • You can amass Photon Spheres

Hero Mag

Thanks to Hero Mag skill, any points added to a mag's S-ATK, R-ATK, and T-ATK will be distributed to all attacks at 1:1 rate. So if you have 200 T-ATK mag, you'll also gain 200 S-ATK and 200 R-ATK.

Preferably your mag has this following setup:

Parameter Value Description
T-ATK 200 Focusing on pure T-ATK will give you access to the exclusive, PP Restore J.
Photon Blast Cetus Proi You'll automatically get Cetus Proi upon focusing on T-ATK. You can buy PB Device Cetus P (PBデバイス／ケートスP) from the Excube shop.
Auto Action Megid Megid is a powerful auto action and can poison enemy. Along with Talis and Mag Excite Ring, your mag can contribute damage comparable to S4 Raising Pursuit. You can buy T-ATK Device Megid (法撃デバイス／メギド) from the Excube Shop
Auto SP Action Barricade (鉄壁 Unbreakable) I personally prefer this since in higher difficulty bosses can do a lot of damage in a single bow; this can be a lifesaver when you least expect it. You can buy SP DEX Device Barricade (SP技量デバイス／鉄壁 SP DEX Device Iron Wall) from the Excube Shop. If you have PP trouble, pick Rapid Fire. Dance is hardly useful because it's hard to time it properly with your burst attacks.

Skill Tree

Hero's skill tree doesn't require too much details. For general purpose, you can just use Recommended Setting, but it will skip putting points on those stat boosters. Generally take everything except the optional skills, listed below.

About Hero Boost and Hero Counter

Hero Boost gives 80% damage increase, but if you lose 20% of your max HP in 5 seconds (regardless of current HP), you also lose 20% damage, bringing you down to 60%. Hero Boost will build this back by 1% per second, or you can do 1 Hero Counter to bring it back to 80%.

Caution! Hero Step is not as good as Phantom, Etoile, or Luster step: you can still get hit after the "Shing!" sound effect if your response is slow (like me).

  • You can assign helpful rings on your units: Atomizer Lovers and Party of Toughness

Sword

To know the basics of Sword, please do the Hero Training Quest on Sword. Sword is the easiest weapon to use and used to be the only Hero weapon, delegating the other two to just utility. Now, it's still the most balanced weapon and safest to use. If you want to start using Hero, start with Sword.

Strength Weakness
Easy to use.Deadly from middle range.Main DPS combo has both invulnerability frames and guard frames.Has a charge ability to do huge damage while waiting for boss. PP consumption is exceedingly high.Have little means to regain PP.Counterattacking forces you to land.

Spirit Bullet Charge 1気弾チャージ①Spirit Bullet Charge 1 Fires a single bullet that penetrates target, with guard frames upon activation.With Combo Aura Shot skill, you can perform this without charging after using any of Sword's attacks.
Spirit Bullet Charge 2気弾チャージ②Spirit Bullet Charge 2 Requires Aura High Charge SkillDoes high amount of damage, but low DPS (less than normal attacks loop)Use this when a boss is about to appear or about to expose weak point.

Brightblade BusterブライトネスエンドBrightness End Hold to charge for a second slash that consumes 40 PP.Powerful against multiple targets, but the PP consumption is poor.Has guard point when performing both slashes, but not when charging.

Sword Combo

Combo 1
Bulletblitz Weapon Action (Spirit Bullet)
Requires Combo Aura Shot.This is an easy combo and is quite sustainable.On high altitude, this increases your survival with the combination of guard frames and invulnerability frames.
Combo 2
2x Bulletblitz Normal 3
Requires Combo Aura Shot.Sword's strongest sustainable comboCan be awkward to use due to the second PA requires you to be close for the Normal 3 to hit.Tap the Weapon Action if you need to restart the normal attack rotation.
Combo 3
Trickflash Hero Time Finish
Useful to close in to your enemy before unleashing the sword's easy to hit Hero Time Finish.
Combo 4
2x Rising Slash Normal 3
Hold each Rising Slash just enough so you can do one airborne slash to it's vertical slam.Sword's most powerful combo, but can only be done on ground.Cannot do proper damage against high altitude or aerial target, so it's usage is limited

TMG

To know the basics of TMG, please do the Hero Training Quest on TMG. TMG reward aggressive play with its powerful counterattack, while keeping the safe side by staying at mid-range.

Strength Weakness
High aerial capabilityAble to refill PP quickly.Main DPS has invulnerability frames.Has no need for combo to do maximum damage.Strongest normal attack.Stongest counter. Subject to range penalty, attacking from too far will result in reduced damage.Have to attack that fills PP.Single-hit Hero Time Finisher often subjected to damage cap.

Talis

To know the basics of Talis, please do the Hero Training Quest on Talis. Talis hits hard and is relatively lenient on it's PP consumption. It builds the Hero focus fastest, and also have the strongest Hero Time Finish.

Strength Weakness
High aerial capabilityCasting Techs mid-air causes you to float, allowing you to keep your aerial combat height.Can warp to high altitude easily, creating instant vantage point.Combos can be reset easily with warping.Hero Focus/Gear fills quickest. Main DPS is neither agile nor has protective frames.Weakest normal attack.Hero Time Finisher is powerful but takes long to do full-damage.

Talis Photon Arts

Icon Name Property
Agile Shift高速移動Agile Shift Hold and release to launch a teleport point.Press to warp into the teleport point.Does minor damage upon hitting enemy.Teleport point can be manually aimed, you can use this to launch yourself to high altitude and mombard your target from there.
Jet WheelジェットホイールJet Wheel Pulls enemy together in an area.Useful to build focus, but the DPS itself is low.
HoundbladeワイズハウンドWise Hound Does damage over time to an enemy part.Builds the focus quickly, but the DPS is low.Don't hold the button too long as you'll lose height.
Fallback GambitダイブオブバレットDive Bullet Similar to sword's Buletblitz, but faster and less invulnerability frames.PP cost is low, but so does the DPS.Useful to reposition yourself as the main DPS roots you in place.Hold to swap to TMG while keeping your position.
Edgeracer GambitレーサーオブエッジRacer Edge Talis' main DPS and can penetrate through enemy.Powerful, but has high PP cost.You can use this after pulling enemy with Jet Wheel as a makeshift area attack.Hold to warp to enemy and swap to sword; this is useful to do Hero Time Finish with the sword if you're unsure that the Talis Hero Time Finish can do full damage.

Part 3: Advanced Hero

Advanced Objectives:
  • You can create a low cost but potent units
  • You can create a potent PP units
  • You know PP efficiency alternative to pure damage

Units

For damage purpose, Hero uses corresponding attack based on the equipped weapon. For easier time, put some HP on your units. For further information on units, please take a look on the companion guide, linked below!

Units

Weapons

As with units, use whatever's available. The weapons listed below are more less, commonly used and/or easy to obtain. If you struggle to obtain a ★15, Atra Ex and Austere can be made easily.

Reminder to transfer your S-Class Abilities, not use the weapon as fodder!
Icon Name S-Slot Description
Cras Similar to Ayer with 30s damage boost mode and higher stat.Requires a Graeae, currently very limited in circulationActivating damage boost mode requires doing 3 normal attacks in a row, step attack doesn’t count.Activating damage boost mode removes the PP cut and persistent PP regenration.
Ayer Provides persistent PP regeneration and PP cut.By putting Petalgleam / Red Petal Flash and S4 Rainbow Balance, this weapon lowers your PP cost a lot.As strong as fully-boosted Stil.Easy to purchase from Zieg.Unless you get it as drop, you will need Grind Caps to increase the cap; fortunatel Grind Caps becomes an easy drop later on.

(Sodam) This is the weapon drop from Ultimate Quest Sodam and only useful if you don't have anything else and is prone to mistakes.All weapons have different names, but has same potential that allows you to use mate items instantly.You'll never need to use mate items instantly as you're actively tring to avoid damage.
Adel A great Hr-exclusive weapon that is easy to obtain.This weapon slows down Hero Time focus drain when equpped, regardless of what weapon you activate with; allowing you to extend Hero Time on-demand, especially when boss suddenly go through a phase change.Also doubles the maximum number of Hero Time Counter focus gain during Hero time from 8 to 16.Permanently available via Collection File, and collection File provides Grind Caps.Overall weaker than Ayer.

Atlas Ex Prevents death once, if you're prone to making mistake.Can obtain at least 2 copies easily.Very straightforward potential.S4 can be used to put persistent PP regeneration like Colossal Radiance.None.
